TITLE: Step 2: Explore the target digital product
INTRO: Explore the digital product to understand its purpose, functionality, and use. This step helps you determine which views to use for the evaluation in the next steps. Identify the technologies used to provide the product and, if you want, take notes on other aspects of the product. Usually it's best to get input from the product owners and developers for this step.
RESOURCE_LINK_NAME: Step 2: Explore the target digital product
INF_RELIEDUP_TECH: Identify the technologies [relied upon according to WCAG 2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-relied-upon) to provide the  product. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 2.4: Identify technologies relied upon](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step2d).
INF_NOTE_TAKING: This section lets you record information during your exploration of the digital product. The notes in the next step help you select samples for evaluation. **These notes are not included in the final report.** They are saved with the file and are available when you reopen it.
LABEL_ESSENT_FUNC: Essential functionality of the digital product
INF_ESSENT_FUNC:
You can use this field to take notes about essential functionality of the digital product. Examples of essential functionality include:
  • selecting and purchasing a product from the web shop
  • completing and submitting the survey forms
  • registering for an account on the product
For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 2.2: Identify essential functionality of the digital product](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step2b).
INF_VARIETY_PAGE_TYPES:
You can use this field to take notes about the types (as opposed to instances) of views that you find in the digital product. This includes notes about different styles, layouts, structures, and functionality provided in the digital product. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 2.3: Identify the variety of sample types](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step2c).
**Note**: “Samples” include all different states within a sample; see the principle of [product enclosure](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em-2/#principle-of-product-enclosure).
